accepted.s: Vigyan Prasar is an autonomous organisation under which of the following?
o: Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology
Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Human Resource Development
accepted.x: Vigyan Prasar is an autonomous organisation of the Department of Science and Technology under the Ministry of Science and Technology. It was set up in 1989 at New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Use the parent-department trap by distinguishing DST from the Ministry of Education.
accepted.sec: Vigyan Prasar - parent department and science communication platforms

accepted.s: Vigyan Prasar was established in:
accepted.x: Vigyan Prasar was established in 1989 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the close institutional establishment years.
accepted.sec: Vigyan Prasar - parent department and science communication platforms

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding DD Science and India Science:
1. DD Science is a one-hour daily science slot on DD National.
2. India Science is an Internet-based science channel run by Vigyan Prasar.
3. Both platforms were launched on 15 January 2019.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: DD Science is a one-hour daily science slot on DD National, while India Science is an Internet-based science channel run by Vigyan Prasar. Both were launched on 15 January 2019.
accepted.tq: Test a platform table by combining nature, operator and launch date.
accepted.sec: Vigyan Prasar - parent department and science communication platforms

accepted.s: DD Science and India Science were launched together on:
accepted.x: The two science communication platforms were launched together on 15 January 2019 by the Union Minister for Science and Technology.
accepted.tq: Use the exact launch-date distinction among nearby national dates.
accepted.sec: Vigyan Prasar - parent department and science communication platforms

accepted.s: Vigyan Dhara is best described as:
o: A DST umbrella scheme merging three schemes relating to capacity building, research and innovation
An autonomous body for grassroots innovations under NITI Aayog
A radio network operated by IGNOU
A single television channel for school education
accepted.x: Vigyan Dhara is a DST umbrella scheme merging schemes concerning S&T institutional and human capacity building, research and development, and innovation, technology development and deployment.
accepted.tq: Identify the umbrella-scheme concept rather than a communication channel or institution.
accepted.sec: Vigyan Prasar - parent department and science communication platforms

accepted.s: Vigyan Dhara, as an umbrella scheme, was approved in:

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: India Science — One-hour daily slot on DD National
DD Science — Internet-based OTT science channel
DD Science and India Science — Two science communication platforms launched together in 2019
Vigyan Dhara — FM radio counterpart of Gyan Darshan
accepted.x: DD Science is the one-hour daily slot on DD National and India Science is the Internet-based channel run by Vigyan Prasar. They were launched together in 2019; Gyan Vani, not Vigyan Dhara, is the FM counterpart of Gyan Darshan.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched platform by separating television, Internet and radio services.

accepted.s: The National Innovation Foundation-India was set up in March 2000 with the support of:
o: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research
accepted.x: NIF-India was set up in March 2000 with the support of the Department of Science and Technology and functions as an autonomous body of DST.
accepted.tq: Use the parent-department trap to identify the institutional sponsor.
accepted.sec: National Innovation Foundation (NIF) - parent department, status, competitions, origin

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes the mandate of the National Innovation Foundation?
o: To scout, support and spread grassroots technological innovations and outstanding traditional knowledge
To regulate all patent applications in India
To operate national educational television channels
To conduct advanced research exclusively with foreign institutions
accepted.x: NIF's mandate is to scout, support and spread grassroots technological innovations and outstanding traditional knowledge. It is not mandated to conduct advanced research exclusively with foreign institutions.
accepted.tq: Reject the wrong-activity trap by identifying the institution's actual mandate.
accepted.sec: National Innovation Foundation (NIF) - parent department, status, competitions, origin

accepted.s: The National Innovation Foundation grew out of the:
accepted.x: NIF grew out of the Honey Bee Network, associated with Prof. Anil K. Gupta, SRISTI and IIM Ahmedabad.
accepted.tq: Link the institution to its origin network and reject unrelated science platforms.
accepted.sec: National Innovation Foundation (NIF) - parent department, status, competitions, origin

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT associated with the National Innovation Foundation?

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Indian Science Congress events in chronological order:
A. First session at the Asiatic Society, Kolkata
B. 88th session in New Delhi
C. 108th session at RTM Nagpur University

Select the correct answer:
accepted.x: The first session was held in 1914, the 88th session in 2001, and the 108th session in January 2023. Therefore, the order is A, B, C.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the intermediate session.
